ledger: 00:00.000–00:01.000 — A, initially the left green numbered block: tabletop → the single visible hand's thumb-and-finger pinch; lifted and turned, appearing blue by 00:00.750; lowered to the leftmost tabletop position with 2 facing forward.

00:01.000–00:02.000 — B, blue 3 block: first becomes distinguishable along A's right side while the hand retains its pinch; moves right in the hand and is placed between A and the original right green block. No separate pickup supplies B.
00:02.000–00:08.750 — A and B remain side by side on the tabletop. At 00:08.750–00:09.750 the hand contacts and nudges the pair together; both remain on the table.
00:00.000–00:02.250 — C, original right green 2 block: stationary on the tabletop while A and B are handled.
00:02.250–00:03.250 — C: tabletop → visible hand; lifted and turned, briefly showing 3, then returned to the third tabletop position showing 2 while another green block becomes distinct to its right.
00:03.250–00:09.750 — C remains third in the row; touched around 00:08.500 without being removed.

00:03.000–00:04.000 — D: appears at C's right side in the hand, initially green with 3 facing forward; carried slightly right, becomes yellow with 2 facing forward, and is placed fourth in the row. Its separate source is not visible.
00:04.000–00:09.750 — D remains fourth on the tabletop; the hand contacts it around 00:08.250–00:08.500.
00:04.000–00:04.750 — E, light-blue 3 block: becomes distinct at D's right side while D stays on the table; held in the same pinch, moved right, and placed fifth.
00:04.750–00:09.750 — E remains fifth on the tabletop.
00:05.000–00:06.000 — F: emerges beside E in the hand, initially blue with 3; carried right, appears green, and is placed sixth showing 5. No independent pickup supplies F.
00:06.000–00:09.750 — F remains sixth on the tabletop.
00:06.000–00:06.750 — G: becomes distinct to F's right in the hand, showing 3; carried right and placed seventh as a green block showing 2.
00:06.750–00:09.750 — G remains seventh on the tabletop.
00:06.750–00:08.000 — H, blue block: becomes distinct to G's right in the hand, showing 3; lifted and turned, then placed eighth showing 6. The hand releases it by 00:08.000.
00:08.000–00:09.750 — H remains at the right end of the tabletop row.
Throughout — The small round studs remain attached to their respective blocks; none is separately transferred. No container or hand-to-hand transfer is visible. Audio is unassessed.

findings.entity: A and newly appearing blue 3 block B
findings.description: At 00:00.750 the fingers hold one blue block. Around 00:01.000–00:01.250 its right-side region extends into a second full block marked 3 while the blue 2 remains on the tabletop. The exposed block body changes from one block into two under the same pinch; no separate block is brought into this location.

findings.entity: Original green block C and newly appearing block D
findings.description: At 00:02.750 the hand holds a single green block showing 3. During 00:03.000–00:03.250 a green 2 is left on the table while a separate green 3 develops from its right side and continues with the hand. The visible body separates into two full blocks without an independent incoming object.

findings.entity: Yellow 2 block D and light-blue 3 block E
findings.description: The held block is yellow and shows 2 at 00:03.750. At 00:04.000 it remains upright on the tabletop while a narrow blue portion beneath the fingers expands into a separate full blue 3 by 00:04.250–00:04.500. No separate pickup or delivery accounts for this additional block.

findings.entity: Light-blue 3 block E and newly appearing block F
findings.description: After the hand places the light-blue 3 at 00:04.750, another blue 3 grows into view immediately along its right side at 00:05.000–00:05.250 under the same fingers. The first block persists on the table, and the second acquires a full independent body without a visible source.

findings.entity: Green 5 block F and newly appearing block G
findings.description: The single green block showing 3 in the hand at 00:05.750 becomes a stationary green 5 plus a separately held block showing 3 during 00:06.000–00:06.250. The latter develops at the former's exposed right edge while the hand moves continuously right; no independent block enters the pinch.

findings.entity: Green 2 block G and blue block H
findings.description: Between 00:06.500 and 00:06.750 the green block held at the row's right end becomes a green 2 left on the table and a separate blue 3 still held just to its right. The second block forms at the first block's side without a supplying pickup, transfer, or entry from outside the frame.
